category_title: Students who become expressionless when their intelligence is publicly mocked
scenario_title: Public math problem solving after quiz collection
minimal_context: Javier is called to the board in front of his math class to solve a problem and show his work after quizzes were collected.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Now you got to show your work. Javier, come to the board to solve a problem.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Walks to the board in front of the class to solve the problem.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Go ahead and write out your solution.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Attempts the problem on the board, writing out the steps, but gets the wrong answer.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: You need to do it like you are in kindergarten, that way you make no mistakes, right? Write this 17 times. (Writes "17 times" on the board) Right, Javier?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Looks at the board expressionless, completely withdrawing and silencing himself as an act of protest and disengagement.)
